acceptanceCriteria: Read each of the ten pinned reference files individually at the locked local reference commit.
Record a non-empty classification and reason for every scoped path, with an explicit Rust counterpart or an evidence-backed reference-only/not-applicable boundary.
Preserve the source-only, revision-bound, provider-owned, and historical evidence boundaries; do not copy source bytes into Runtime authority or adopter state.
Update the tri-language comparison/parity documentation and inventory without leaving a migrate-gap for this slice.
Pass inventory, documentation, parity, governance, and the declared Runtime verification checks.
Deliver through a reviewed PR and exact branch/worktree cleanup, then publish the next release only after required release evidence passes.
goal: Resolve the next deferred reference-file comparison slice without copying source implementation, source evidence, or source-specific governance decisions.
intent: Compare the next bounded set of pinned reference files individually and record whether their responsibilities are implemented differently, equivalent, not applicable, or intentionally reference-only in the Rust Runtime.
outOfScope: Runtime code changes unless a directly evidenced in-scope parity defect is found and the Contract is amended.
